meta.title: To-do list
meta.description: A to-do list in the right sidebar, stored on this machine and shared by every conversation, readable and editable by the model too. Each task can carry a due date, a flag, a priority (low/medium/high) and notes, all shared with the same fields in Apple Reminders, several Reminders lists can be synced at once (pick them from the + under the input, applied immediately), and a task can be moved to another list from its settings, which moves the reminder too. Enter adds a task, a tick completes it, × deletes it, ⋯ opens its settings, and Sync now above the list reconciles with Reminders. The list lives in ~/.dsh/dsh-todo/todos.json and is kept in two-way sync: edits on either side win, a field changed differently on both sides resolves in DSH favour, and deleting a whole Reminders list rebuilds it instead of deleting tasks. Tasks completed more than 30 days ago are cleared from Reminders while DSH keeps the history. The model reads and writes the same list through the personal_todos tool, including these fields. Turning the plugin off keeps the file.
